title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Breese Pitt Dixon careers page (read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT): land development civil engineering, surveying and planning in Melbourne for over 40 years; designs major estates and infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads. Looking for graduate and experienced civil engineers, draftspersons and others. 'We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au'.
apply_instructions: Email an introduction with CV and a short note to info@bpd.com.au (published on https://www.bpd.com.au/careers).
